title: ci(bundle-analysis): retire the exhausted-headroom leg, keep every ceiling
body:
Fixes #10148

Clause-②: no — an internal CI gate's own leg. It moves no exported symbol and no key on a published payload.

`Bundle Analysis` is red on `main` and three finished pull requests are parked behind it. ⛔ Every budget in this gate passes on `main` today; what fails is a leg that judges how much headroom a ceiling has LEFT. The maintainer ruled that leg out. This retires it and ⛔ touches no ceiling.

## The ruling — recorded VERBATIM and UNTRANSLATED

Maintainer, 2026-09-20, on objectui#10148. Rewriting a ruling is rewriting the decision, so both utterances are carried in the language they were made in, in order:

> 10148 i18n-locale-en 天花板余量 不需要这是天花板余量

> 10148 不需要设置天花板余量

⇒ it is the headroom REQUIREMENT that is not wanted. ⛔ Not the row the first utterance names: `i18n-locale-en` keeps its ceiling at the value it had, and a build that puts that chunk over it still exits 1.

## The enumeration, taken BEFORE any row was cut

`git grep` over the whole tree, uncapped, for every identifier carrying the word headroom in any case, run and counted BEFORE any row was read. ⚠️ The figures below are that ONE reading, taken on `eb1c9f9d2` — a historical record of what this cut was decided against, ⛔ not a live count and ⛔ not re-derived by anything. 8 distinct identifiers, 94 occurrences, across 9 files:

| identifier | occurrences | verdict |
|---|--:|---|
| `EXHAUSTED_HEADROOM_FLOOR_MULTIPLE` | 11 | ⛔ OUT — the floor itself |
| `EXHAUSTED_HEADROOM_ALLOWANCES` | 14 | ⛔ OUT — debt held against that floor |
| `EXHAUSTED_HEADROOM_ALLOWANCE_GRANULARITY_MULTIPLE` | 8 | ⛔ OUT — the unit those pinned figures were compared in |
| `evaluateHeadroomSensitivity` | 34 | ✅ STAYS — it owns the blind leg too |
| `closure_headroom_status` | 11 | ✅ STAYS — see the workflow note below |
| `closureHeadroomStatus` | 7 | ✅ STAYS — `scripts/render-budget-comment.mjs`, out of surface, unedited |
| `BUDGET_CLOSURE_HEADROOM_STATUS` | 2 | ✅ STAYS — the workflow env, out of surface, unedited |
| `atHeadroom` | 7 | ✅ STAYS — `packages/plugin-charts`, unrelated |

⚠️ The three ⛔ OUT identifiers have ⛔ no reader outside this gate and its own test, which is why they could leave together. Three `.changeset/*.md` files mention one of these names — `7479-lazy-locale-catalogues.md` names `EXHAUSTED_HEADROOM_ALLOWANCES`, `5924-live-headroom-invariant.md` names `evaluateHeadroomSensitivity`, `6230-budget-comment-half-status.md` names `closure_headroom_status`. All three are published historical record about the tree they were written for, and are ⛔ left exactly as they stand.

## Removed, in full

From `scripts/check-eager-closure-budget.mjs`:

1. `EXHAUSTED_HEADROOM_FLOOR_MULTIPLE` and its doc block.
2. `EXHAUSTED_HEADROOM_ALLOWANCES` and its doc block.
3. `EXHAUSTED_HEADROOM_ALLOWANCE_GRANULARITY_MULTIPLE` and its doc block.
4. The `floorFor` predicate, the `floorBytes` and `allowanceGrainBytes` derivations, and the `exhausted` row set.
5. The `N ceiling is EXHAUSTED` headline, and both remedy prose blocks under it — the find-the-bytes one and the ALREADY-declared-exhausted one.
6. The declared-allowance clause the table appended to a listed row's band.
7. The `exhausted` field of this half's return shape, its `@returns` union, and the `floorMultiple` / `allowances` / `allowanceGrainMultiple` parameters.
8. The exit-2 clause in `main`'s doc that named a ceiling with no headroom left.

From `scripts/__tests__/check-eager-closure-budget.test.ts`: the whole `the exhausted end (objectui#8554)` describe — 16 cases across 3 nested describes — the `exits 2 when a ceiling has no headroom left to measure with` case, and the three retired imports.

## Rewritten, ⛔ not deleted — the prohibition this change contradicts

The gate's own text said, and its failure output printed:

> ⛔ Never lower `EXHAUSTED_HEADROOM_FLOOR_MULTIPLE`, and ⛔ never add a row to `EXHAUSTED_HEADROOM_ALLOWANCES` to silence this

⭐ That was written about a SEAT reaching for the knob because a build had gone red — which is correct, and is exactly what was happening when this card was filed. It was ⛔ never a bar on the maintainer, and the charter's priority order puts 维护者裁决 above it.

⇒ a `RETIRED` block now stands where those constants stood. It records what the leg did, objectui#8554's argument for it as history rather than as a live claim, the prohibition quoted intact, who is allowed to overrule it, the ruling verbatim, and that re-adding the leg is a maintainer decision rather than a repair. ⛔ A silent deletion leaves a header arguing for a leg that is gone, and the next reader puts it back. A unit case pins that block — including a CJK-run match, because the second utterance is Chinese end to end and a translation is what would remove it.

⚠️ The history that explains the CEILINGS was ⛔ not taken out with the leg. `Why i18n-locales became i18n-locale-en`, the objectui#8554 account, the objectui#8816 re-pin and the objectui#9251 paydown all stay; four passages that asserted the floor as a LIVE predicate were reworded to say the 0.10x is a sizing CONVENTION again, which is what it was before objectui#8554 promoted it.

## What the gate still refuses

- A chunk OVER any `PER_CHUNK_GZIP_CEILINGS` row — exit 1. ⭐ Including `i18n-locale-en`, whose ceiling is ⛔ unchanged.
- The aggregate closure over `MAX_EAGER_CLOSURE_GZIP_BYTES` — exit 1.
- The entry-chunk budget in the workflow — untouched.
- A ceiling more than one whole regression ABOVE its payload, the BLIND leg — exit 2. ⛔ Not ruled on, so ⛔ not removed.
- A missing, stale-shaped or internally inconsistent report, and a budgeted chunk absent from it — exit 2.
- Ceiling freshness: a ceiling the base branch replaced after this checkout — exit 2.

⇒ a chunk that goes over its ceiling still reds. A chunk that is merely close to it does not.

## ⚠️ The workflow is NOT edited, and here is why it did not have to be

`.github/workflows/performance-budget.yml` reads `closure_headroom_status` as `BUDGET_CLOSURE_HEADROOM_STATUS`, and that file is out of surface. That output is the SENSITIVITY half's status, ⛔ not the exhausted leg's: the blind leg stays, so the half stays, so the output stays. `scripts/__tests__/render-budget-comment.test.ts`, which pins that every key this gate publishes is consumed by the comment step, passes unchanged — 37 of 37.

⭐ The headroom FIGURES stay in the report as well. Every row still prints its headroom in KB and as a multiple of the regression. Printing a number is reporting; failing a build on it is the requirement that was retired, and the two separated cleanly because only the predicate read the floor.

## The pin: RED-before / GREEN-after on the BEHAVIOUR

⛔ Not on the constant's absence — a pin written that way passes the moment the identifier is deleted, whatever the gate then does. The pair is one fixture apart, on the SAME chunk and the same ceiling, and both legs ran in one command with the file state read in that same command.

**RED-before**, checker blob `caccffe37` verified equal to its `HEAD` blob in the same command:

```
checker == HEAD ? UNCHANGED
 × main > exits 0 when a chunk sits just UNDER its ceiling — merely close is not a verdict
 ✓ main > still exits 1 when that same chunk goes OVER the same ceiling — the budget stays
 Tests  1 failed | 145 passed (146)
AssertionError: expected 2 to be +0
```

**GREEN-after**, checker blob `67ba3ade2`:

```
checker == HEAD ? MODIFIED
 ✓ main > exits 0 when a chunk sits just UNDER its ceiling — merely close is not a verdict
 ✓ main > still exits 1 when that same chunk goes OVER the same ceiling — the budget stays
 Tests  135 passed (135)
```

⭐ The over-by-one case is the CONTROL and it is green on BOTH sides. A run where only the first case moved would not distinguish "the headroom leg was removed" from "the budget was removed". Five unit cases sit beside it on `evaluateHeadroomSensitivity` itself, each carrying its own same-subject control — including one call in which the tight row passes and the AGGREGATE ceiling errors as blind, in the same table.

## ⭐ The reading this gate now takes on a REAL console build

`pnpm turbo run build --filter='./packages/*'` then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console build`, on this branch, producing `apps/console/dist/eager-closure.json` — sha256 `440c84ebf568…`. The SAME report file was then weighed twice, by two scripts, in the same command.

**CONTROL — `main`'s gate** (blob `caccffe37`, read out of `HEAD` and verified equal to it in that command). This reproduces the incident exactly:

```
MAIN_GATE_EXIT=2
✅ Console eager closure is 3058.9 KB gzipped (budget: 3104.5 KB, headroom: 45.6 KB).
✅ Per-chunk eager budgets (4 chunks weighed)  — all four ✅
❌ 1 ceiling is EXHAUSTED — under 0.10x of one 89.0 KB regression
  ❌ chunk `i18n-locale-en`   40.0 KB measured / 48.8 KB ceiling (headroom 8.8 KB = 0.10x)
```

**THIS BRANCH's gate**, same report:

```
BRANCH_GATE_EXIT=0
✅ Console eager closure is 3058.9 KB gzipped (budget: 3104.5 KB, headroom: 45.6 KB).
✅ Per-chunk eager budgets (4 chunks weighed)  — all four ✅
✅ Ceiling sensitivity (5 ceilings, each weighed against the report just read)
  ✅ chunk `i18n-locale-en`   40.0 KB measured / 48.8 KB ceiling (headroom 8.8 KB = 0.10x the 89.0 KB regression)
```

⇒ the closure-budget step of `Bundle Analysis` goes green on a measured build, with the row still printed and its ceiling still in force. ⚠️ That is a reading of THIS step. `Bundle Analysis` also runs the entry budget, the package-size report and `check:sdui-registration-pins`; none of those is touched here and none was red in the incident reading.

⚠️ ⛔ The card's second acceptance question — how close `i18n-locale-en` had been to the floor BEFORE the bytes that crossed it — is ⛔ NOT answered here. Answering it needs a build per candidate commit, and the ruling removed the line the question was about. ⛔ Recorded as open rather than quietly dropped.

## Verification

All of the below ran with the worktree verified CLEAN and identical to the pushed commit `c2f45b9eb`, nothing staged, 0 untracked, and the two file blobs verified equal to their `HEAD` blobs in the same command.

| check | result |
|---|---|
| `pnpm check:eager-closure` (real build) | exit 0 |
| `pnpm check:eager-locale-catalogues` | exit 0 — en resident, 9 deferred, unchanged |
| `vitest run` both affected suites | exit 0 — 172 of 172, 2 files |
| `pnpm type-check:scripts` | exit 0 — `--listFiles` confirms BOTH surface files are in the 1024-file project, so it is not a vacuous pass |
| `pnpm lint:root` | exit 0 — 32 warnings, 0 errors; eslint's own JSON output puts both surface files in its 386-file population at 0 errors and 0 warnings each |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | exit 0 — 0 published-source files changed, no changeset owed. Decided by RUNNING the gate |
| `pnpm check:control-bytes` | exit 0 — 8140 tracked text files scanned |
| `pnpm check:new-line-citations` | exit 0 — 0 new citations |
| `pnpm check:test-path-roots` | exit 0 |
| `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` (final file list) | exit 0 — NOT GOVERNED, 2 paths against 5 surfaces |

⚠️ ⛔ Not claimed: the repo-wide `pnpm test` and `pnpm lint` (turbo, per package) are CI's runs and were ⛔ not taken here. `Bundle Analysis` on this pull request is the reading that governs, and it has not reported yet.

## Landing

⛔ Stays DRAFT. ⛔ No label applied, ⛔ auto-merge not armed, ⛔ not flipped ready — the claiming seat lands it. ⛔ Nothing on objectui#10147, objectui#10149 or objectui#10101 was touched; those remain open and are ⛔ not addressed by this pull request.
